hero.title: About Shri Nathuram Maharaj Mahavidyalaya
hero.description: Providing quality education with a focus on Civil Services and Kirtan Shastra.

overview.introduction: Shri Nathuram Maharaj Mahavidyalaya is a recognized institution of higher learning affiliated to Kavikulaguru Kalidas Sanskrit University, Ramtek, Nagpur. We specialize in B.A. programs geared towards Civil Services (MPSC/UPSC) and Kirtan Shastra.
overview.history: Dedicated to providing excellent academic programs in the heart of Parbhani district.

visionMission.vision: To empower students with the knowledge and values needed to excel in civil services and preserve cultural heritage through Kirtan Shastra.
visionMission.mission: To impart high-quality education and training for competitive exams while promoting traditional knowledge systems.

principal.name: Dr. Balaji Munde
principal.message: Welcome to our college. We are committed to shaping the future of our students and guiding them towards success in their chosen paths.

whyChooseUs.title: Civil Services Focus
whyChooseUs.description: Curriculum tailored for MPSC and UPSC exams.

whyChooseUs.title: Govt. Scholarships
whyChooseUs.description: ST, SC, VJNT, OBC & OPEN scholarships available.

objectives: To provide targeted education for civil services aspirants.
To promote the study of Kirtan Shastra.
To ensure access to education for all through scholarships.
